newsitem.title: USA: Robb Peck McCooey opens muni underwriting dept.
newsitem.headline: Robb Peck McCooey opens muni underwriting dept.

text.p: Robb Peck McCooey Clearing Corp has thrown its hat into the municipal underwriting ring, hiring Bob Cembor to launch a new department.

"Robb Peck McCooey is the second oldest specialist house on the Street. They've been in business for over 60 years," said Cembor, who joined the New York City-based firm as a vice president of underwriting July 16.
While the firm's primary focus is equities, it believes now is a good time to get into the municipal underwriting business, he said.
"They have over 20 retail reps here now, and some of the customers have the municipal product, and (Robb Peck) wants to be full service, and offer more product to their customer base," Cembor said.
The firm, which plans to underwrite both negotiated and competitive offerings, has had a municipal trader -- Gene Gulka -- on staff as a vice president for about a year, Cembor said.
"We'll be looking to grow, but we want to grow the right way," he said.
Cembor, a former manager of Compass Mutual Funds for Midlantic Bank, has been in the industry for roughly 30 years.
